title: Parking Lots
content: Parking lots carry an unavoidable sense of dread. Their circular driveways spiral upwards yet feed into the street - designed for convenience, yet they somehow create more confusion. Attendants are present but rarely attentive. Retrieving your car becomes an unintended expedition through a maze of city and suburban streets, each turn making you question whether you’ll ever find it. And when you finally do, it’s just a nondescript garage—your car inexplicably worse for wear.
